diagnostics.message: "conformance token" already selects the reading at array position 0 ("conformance-entidade-canonica"). A token both readings claim leaves the surface form exactly as ambiguous as it was before — a coin flip with paperwork. The disambiguating token must be the thing that actually differs in what the customer says.
